placements.quote: The NA60 experiment studies muon pair production at the CERN SPS.

summary.plain: A silicon vertex telescope right behind the target and a muon spectrometer, giving a very accurate measurement of the masses of muon pairs produced in collisions.
summary.technical: NA60: pixel vertex telescope in a dipole magnet in front of the NA50-type muon spectrometer, with a mass resolution of about 2% for the 360000-dimuon In-In sample.

technology.quote: The unprecedented sample size of 360 000 dimuons and the good mass resolution of about 2% allow us to isolate the excess by subtraction of the decay sources.
technology.value: Muon spectrometer coupled to a silicon-pixel vertex telescope
